text: Tara Chand is a politician and leader from Jammu and Kashmir. He served as Deputy Chief Minister of the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir from 2009 to 2014 and had previously held the position of Speaker of the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly. On 30 August 2022, he resigned from the Indian National Congress in support of Ghulam Nabi Azad and was subsequently appointed as Vice Chairperson of the Democratic Azad Party. However, on 22 December 2022, he was removed from the Democratic Azad Party due to allegations of 'anti-party' activities. In the 2014 elections, Chand lost to BJP candidate Dr. Krishan Lal in the Chhamb Assembly constituency of Jammu district. In the 2024 election, he finished in third place.
